notes.text: Don't retry the refresh_token grant as is, not even via withRetry. Keyline rotates refresh tokens and revokes the whole family when a used one is re-sent. A timeout can hit after the server rotated, so a plain retry signs every device out (keyline/security.md, Token families).
notes.author: codex

notes.text: Safe retry: one Idempotency-Key header reused across all attempts of the same refresh (transport.post(path, body, { headers })). Keyline replays the first response for 60 s and skips reuse detection (keyline/request-headers.md). New key per refresh token.
notes.author: codex

notes.text: SessionGuard retries an API call once after a 401. A refresh that fails with 400 invalid_grant is never retried: the family is gone, so sign the user out.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: post() rejects with TransportError (code ETIMEDOUT or ECONNRESET) only when no HTTP response arrived. Extra headers such as Idempotency-Key go in options.headers.
notes.author: claude-code

notes.text: withRetry is for Tokenbox API calls (ADR 0003). Don't wrap Keyline's refresh-token grant in it without an Idempotency-Key: a blind retry after a lost response trips token-family reuse detection and signs every device out.
notes.author: codex
